notes: Couples - married, engaged, dating, partners, divorced, widowed - with an emoji on the line; in-laws work themselves out
Arrange it yourself - hold and drag people around; couples always stay side by side
Lines that explain themselves - who's related to who, labelled, plus dashed "what they are to you" lines (Uncle → you)
People who aren't on Deck OS yet - dashed cards with an invite link that claims their spot; drag to 🕊 In memory
Related how? - "Aunt · Mom's sister" on every profile, and fix a wrong relationship in two taps
🏷 Known nicknames - Nana, Big J… anyone in the family can add one
Pets belong to people ("Mom & Dad's cat") and hang off their owners in the tree
Family in other houses add their own pets with their own jobs - their reminders buzz their house, not yours
Month view in Schedule - every calendar, add / edit / delete, "Did it make it?" check for what Deck OS added
Tap a calendar to recolor it - and see whether it's linked
🍎 Connect iCloud - 4 numbered steps in the app; then edit, move and delete iCloud events (colors match your iPhone)
Brain dump files to the right calendar - "add laundry to the home calendar", "Sam has soccer at 6" → Soccer - Sam on Family;
